hab: Data centres the size of towns
bio: A black gecko hatchling with one glowing green scale on its back. It sticks to warm walls and hums when it thinks.
A glossy black lizard whose back spines glow like a row of cards. It runs hot, so it is always looking for a fan.
A great black dragon-lizard that spreads its wings before every move, and the lights in town dim. Every keynote it gives ends with a bigger number.
note: Every scale it grows is worth more than the last one.
Sells the same spine to everyone, and everyone queues.
Its value doubled while you read this.
